_comment: cron-job.org bulk import config for Coolify/Hostinger deployment. Import these jobs at https://cron-job.org. Set the URL to https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/api/cron/{path} and add request header 'x-cron-secret: YOUR_CRON_SECRET'. All times are UTC.
_setup: 1) Generate CRON_SECRET: openssl rand -hex 32. 2) Set CRON_SECRET env var in Coolify (Project → Environment Variables). 3) Sign up at cron-job.org (FREE). 4) Create each job below with the specified schedule + URL + header. 5) Method: POST (or GET — all routes accept both). 6) Replace YOUR-DOMAIN.com with your actual domain (e.g., fieseros.com). 7) Set timeout to 300 seconds for the daily master (it runs many sub-crons).
_architecture: IMPORTANT: This file contains ALL 7 cron jobs needed for the Coolify deployment: 1 DAILY MASTER cron + 6 HIGH-FREQUENCY crons. The daily master cron (/api/cron/master) fans out to 10 daily sub-crons + sitemap regeneration internally. Do NOT create separate cron-job.org entries for the individual daily sub-crons (marketplace-settlement, recurring-jobs, etc.) — they are all triggered by the master. vercel.json crons do NOT work on Coolify — you MUST use cron-job.org for the daily master.
_coolify_note: This config replaces the Vercel Cron setup. On Coolify/Hostinger, vercel.json is ignored — ALL crons must be triggered externally via cron-job.org (or any external HTTP cron service).
_domain_placeholder: Replace YOUR-DOMAIN.com with your production domain (e.g., fieseros.com) before importing.

jobs.name: daily-master
jobs._comment: MASTER DAILY CRON — fans out to 10 daily sub-crons + sitemap regeneration. Sub-crons: marketplace-settlement, archive-old-won-deals, recurring-jobs, overdue-detector, trial-reminders, pre-charge-reminder, recurring-invoices, trial-expire, renewal, past-due-escalation. On the 1st of each month, also runs sms-quota-reset. Sitemap regeneration runs AFTER all sub-crons (incremental — only regenerates dirty files). 7-day safety net forces full sitemap regen if needed. CRITICAL: this must be set up on Coolify — vercel.json crons don't work.

jobs.name: scheduled-messages
jobs._comment: Dispatches due ScheduledMessage rows (appointment / payment / overdue / follow-up reminders). Time-critical — late runs = customer reminders arrive late.

jobs.name: scheduled-executions
jobs._comment: Fires due delayed workflow automations (replaces setTimeout in trigger-engine). Time-critical — late runs = workflows fire late.

jobs.name: campaigns
jobs._comment: Dispatches scheduled email campaigns whose scheduledAt has passed. 15-min cadence is acceptable for marketing.

jobs.name: appointment-reminders
jobs._comment: Schedules customer reminders for upcoming JobVisits (1h / 24h / 2d before). Has 24h lookahead window so hourly is plenty.

jobs.name: featured-location
jobs._comment: Standalone hourly cron (NOT wired into master). Picks a random European city (population-weighted) from DirectoryLocation and stores it as the current FeaturedLocation, which the homepage reads to render the 'Featured European location' hero.

jobs.name: ai-cleanup
jobs._comment: Releases stale AI call reservations (older than 30 min) so they don't block concurrent-call slots. Also reconciles billing for ended calls whose finalizeUsage() failed (revenue recovery) + runs the phone-number release saga (resumable multi-step). 15-min cadence matches the 30-min staleness threshold — stale reservations are cleared within ~45 min worst case.

_daily_subcrons_handled_by_master: marketplace-settlement (releases held funds to providers via Airwallex)
past-due-escalation (1d/3d/7d escalation + daily digest to platform owner)
_monthly_subcrons_handled_by_master: sms-quota-reset (runs only on the 1st of each month via date guard in master route)
